meta.title: Secure checkout
meta.description: Give us contact and billing details, confirm which Steam account receives the lots, then pay on our provider's secure page.

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.subtitle: Put a skin in the cart before checking out.

errors.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

contact.title: Contact
contact.emailHint: Confirmation, invoice and delivery updates all come to this address.
contact.phoneOptional: Phone number is optional. It is used only when an order runs into trouble.

delivery.title: Billing and Steam delivery
delivery.billingHint: Whatever address your card is registered to. Your invoice carries it.
delivery.steamLead: Items are sent as a {method} to this account, {usual}.
delivery.steamRequired: Connect Steam and store your trade URL before going further.

review.title: Review & pay
review.accept: I have read and agree to the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms> and the <refunds>Refund policy</refunds>.
review.acceptLabelShort: the Terms and Conditions together with the Refund policy
review.hosted: Pressing Pay hands you to our provider's secure page, where the card details go in. No card number is ever typed on this site.
review.processedBy: Card payments are processed securely by {provider}. A full card number is neither seen nor stored by us.
review.processedByProvider: Our PCI DSS compliant provider handles the card processing. Your full card number is neither seen nor kept here.
review.threeDs: Expect your bank to want the payment confirmed in its app, by way of 3-D Secure.
review.waiverNote: Delivery cannot begin until you make that request. Once delivery begins, the {days}-day right to cancel no longer applies. <link>How cancelling works</link>.

merchant.tradingName: {brand} is a trading name of {company}. Company number {number}.

frame.credentials: {brand} is a trading name of {company}, company number {number}, {address}. {email}

paymentFailed.title: That payment was not completed
paymentFailed.body: You haven't been charged. Everything you entered is still there for another attempt.

problems.title: This order could not be taken
problems.PAYMENTS_NOT_CONNECTED: Card payment is being wired up. Nothing has been charged.
problems.PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Card payment is down for the moment, so this order cannot be taken. Nothing has been charged. Please try again later or email {email}.
problems.PAYMENT_LINK_FAILED: The secure payment page would not open. Nothing has been charged. Give it a few minutes and try once more.
problems.TOTAL_CHANGED: The price of an item or the exchange rate has changed, so your total is now {total}. Look it over, then press Pay again.
problems.ORDER_LIMIT: One order can hold up to {max} items. Take something out of the cart to go on.
problems.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: {name} is no longer available. Take it out of the cart to go on.
problems.PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't confirm the current price of {name}. Nothing has been charged. Try once more in a moment.
problems.TRADE_URL_REQUIRED: Store your Steam trade URL first, then pay.
problems.AGE_REQUIRED: You must be {minAge} or over to order. Fill in your date of birth under Account → Profile and return here to pay. Nothing has been charged.
problems.INVALID_REQUEST: Something is missing, or not valid. Work back through the steps and try again.
problems.RATE_LIMITED: That is too many attempts too quickly. Leave it a minute, then try again.
problems.UNAUTHORISED: Your session has ended. Another sign-in is needed to go on.
problems.NETWORK: The store was out of reach. Check the connection, then try again.
problems.SERVER_ERROR: The fault is at our end. Nothing has been charged. Please try again.

meta.title: Order confirmation
meta.description: Where your Veltskins order and its payment stand.

confirmed.when: We send each item as a Steam trade offer, {usual}. Take it in Steam before it lapses. Your order page tracks each lot.

checking.title: Checking your payment
checking.body: The payment is being confirmed with our provider. A few seconds is the usual wait. Leave this page open.

failed.title: The payment did not complete
failed.body: You haven't been charged. Your lots are still in the cart, so try again or reach for a different card.
failed.help: If money has left your account, email {email} and we'll look into it.

pending.title: Confirmation of your payment is still pending
pending.body: Your bank has yet to confirm it. Please don't pay again. We'll email {email} as soon as it's confirmed, or contact {support} if you don't hear from us.

review.title: We're checking your payment
review.body: What our provider confirmed does not match this order, so we have held it and requested no delivery. We'll contact you at {email} {replyTime}.

unavailable.title: This payment cannot be confirmed just now
unavailable.body: Our provider is unreachable for the moment, which is why the order is not yet marked paid. We'll email {email} once it's confirmed, or contact {support}.

missing.title: No order to show
missing.body: This page is for showing an order once payment is done. Just paid? Follow the link in your confirmation email, or look under your orders.

error.title: This order would not load
error.body: Nothing is lost. Try again in a moment, or email {email} with the time of your payment.

signIn.title: Sign in to continue to checkout
signIn.body: A lot travels to a Steam account by trade offer, so checkout needs an account here with Steam connected. Signing in leaves your cart untouched.
